text: In the enhancement debate, Michael Sandel and Julian Savulescu are opposed in which way?
choices: Sandel defends a positive duty to enhance, while Savulescu invokes 'giftedness' against enhancement
Both hold that any enhancement is simply impermissible
Sandel objects that enhancement erodes the good of 'giftedness,' while Savulescu argues for 'procreative beneficence,' a duty to select the child expected to have the best life
Both ground their positions in Nozick's experience machine
explanation: Sandel's giftedness argument warns that the drive to master and design traits erodes openness and unconditional acceptance; Savulescu's procreative beneficence makes selecting the best-expected-life child a positive obligation, directly challenging Sandel. Option A reverses the two thinkers, and B and D misstate both positions.
